turns.prompt_text: I have a bunch of Styrofoam laying around from like old things that me and my roommates have bought is there anything I can do with it
turns.response_html: You can reuse it as lightweight drainage at the bottom of potted plants, break it up for DIY "bean bag" filler, or dissolve it in acetone to create a strong adhesive "polystyrene cement." If it's clean, many shipping centers like UPS or local "hard-to-recycle" facilities may accept it for densification.
